name: ui-floating-action-button
description: FloatingActionButton — UI factory (1:1 with the @almadar/ui floating-action-button pattern).

schema.description: FloatingActionButton — UI factory (1:1 with the @almadar/ui floating-action-button pattern).
schema.name: ui-floating-action-button

action.description: Declarative event name. When set, clicking the FAB emits `UI:{action}` via the event bus and (if also provided) calls `onClick`. Mirrors the Button atom's `action` prop so schemas can write `{ type: 'floating-action-button', action: 'INIT' }` uniformly.
action.label: Action

actionPayload.description: Payload to include with the dispatched action event.
actionPayload.label: Action Payload

actions.description: Multiple actions. When provided, the button expands to show all of them.
actions.label: Actions

icon.description: Icon: a canonical icon name string (resolved by Button) or a Lucide component.
icon.label: Icon

label.description: Optional label shown via `aria-label` (visually hidden in single-action mode; rendered as a tooltip beside expanded actions in multi-action mode).
label.label: Label

onClick.description: Optional direct click handler. Runs after the action emit when both are present.
onClick.label: On Click

emits.description: Declarative event name. When set, clicking the FAB emits `UI:{action}` via the event bus and (if also provided) calls `onClick`. Mirrors the Button atom's `action` prop so schemas can write `{ type: 'floating-action-button', action: 'INIT' }` uniformly.
Optional direct click handler. Runs after the action emit when both are present.

events.description: Declarative event name. When set, clicking the FAB emits `UI:{action}` via the event bus and (if also provided) calls `onClick`. Mirrors the Button atom's `action` prop so schemas can write `{ type: 'floating-action-button', action: 'INIT' }` uniformly.
events.name: @config.action
